submission_definition: rate for the 99 inter-token intervals between generated-token timestamps 1 and 100 after TTFT; 99 / (t100 - t1), timestamps in seconds; 100 events, 99 intervals
prompt_median_definition: ordinary median within each prompt across repeats, then ordinary median of those prompt medians; not prompt-class aggregation or a promotion gate
median_definition: ordinary median of all successful finite positive per-request rates across prompts and repeats; failed/missing/zero rates excluded; never pool distinct windows
decode_definition: (N-1) / (tN - t1), timestamps in seconds; first N=min(64, non-EOG output count) events; 63 intervals ending at tokens 2..64 for N=64
evidence_label: official draft head, draft-only 8-bit requantisation, output identical to sequential decode
